correctness.rationale: The displayed matrices reconstruct exactly. In characteristic \(2\), for \(B= egin{pmatrix}1&1\0&1\end{pmatrix}\) and \(C= egin{pmatrix}1&0\1&0\end{pmatrix}\), direct multiplication gives \([B,C]=B\), so \(E=kB+kC\) is Lie closed. For \(v=(x,y)^{\mathsf T}\), the parameter-to-value matrix is \( egin{pmatrix}x+y&x\y&x\end{pmatrix}\) with determinant \(x^2\); hence only the direction \(x=0\) constrains the algebraic reflexive hull, yielding exactly \(\operatorname{Ref}_a(E)=\{ egin{pmatrix}a&b\c&b\end{pmatrix}\}\). The two submitted hull elements have commutator \( egin{pmatrix}1&0\1&1\end{pmatrix}\), which violates that equation. Dimension \(1\) is impossible because its endomorphism algebra is commutative.
risks: The proof establishes the characteristic-two counterexample and dimension minimality only; it does not classify odd positive characteristic or realize the chosen \(E\) as a full derivation algebra.
